notes.title: Mosaico 1.8.4.4 is available! (Borderless gaming included)
notes.content:
Hi there!

I’m happy to announce that a new update of Mosaico is available! Good news for gamers: Mosaico makes it possible now to run your games in a borderless fullscreen window!   

Here's a brief list of relevant changes:

[list]
[*][b]New “Borderless Windows” feature.[/b] This means easier ALT+TABing out of gaming window and complete multi-monitor support.
[*][b]New “Mouse Locking” feature.[/b] You can lock mouse pointer to your borderless windows. Handy when a game requires interaction near the screen edges.
[*][b]WIN key is now a global shortcut modifier.[/b] You can also select from 0 to 4 modifiers (CTRL, ALT, SHIFT, WIN) to optimally configure your favorite shortcuts.
[*][b]Improved compatibility.[/b] Mosaico now works fine with Acrobat Reader, VLC, Ninja Trader, JRiver and many others, thanks to a completely rewritten inter process communication schema.
[*][b]Many bug fixes and improved speed.[/b] Fixed a crash when dragging windows across multiple screens in Windows 10. Fixed several other smaller issues.
[*][b]Snapshot name is preserved[/b] when replacing it
[*][b]New 1/16 of screen layout elements added[/b]
[*][b]Fixed compatibility issues[/b] with 3rd party apps interfering with Mosaico and causing crashes
[*][b]Mosaico GUI doesn’t disappear immediately[/b] when mouse exits it
[*][b]It is now possible to disable any keyboard shortcuts[/b]
[*][b]Mosaico now works with both Administrator and non-Administrator apps[/b], if you launch it with Administrator privileges
[*][b]Fixed some minor bugs[/b] and hangs in Windows 10
[/list]

Your copy should be automatically updating soon. Please remember that you can run your Steam copy without running the Steam client itself. You can also use the license key provided by Steam to register the retail version!
Retail version is available at [url=www.soulidstudio.com]www.soulidstudio.com[/url]

notes.title: You can now use Steam license to register the retail version!
notes.content:
Hi there!

New in-house built licensing system is finally up and running!
This means that [b]you can use the license code provided via Steam to register the retail version of Mosaico[/b], available at www.soulidstudio.com !

[h1] To get your license code from Steam:[/h1] 
[list]
    [*]Open Steam client
    [*]Right click on Mosaico entry
    [*]Select "Show CD Key"
[/list]

[h1] To register the retail version:[/h1] 
[list]
    [*]Uninstall the Steam version of Mosaico
    [*]Download retail setup at www.soulidstudio.com
    [*]Install and run 
    [*]Select "I have a license code"
    [*]Insert your license code and click "Register"
[/list]

[b]Steam and retail version are functionally the same[/b], but you may want to install your copy of Mosaico where you can't install the Steam client (i.e. at work). 

This was a feature that many users asked for, I hope it can be useful! If you find anything wrong with this, please feel free to comment here or write to info@soulidstudio.com .

Thank you!
Alfredo

notes.title: Mosaico doesn't show "In game: Mosaico" anymore.
notes.content:
Hi there!

It is now possible to run Mosaico without Steam showing your online status as [b]"In game: Mosaico"[/b].

This feature has been largely requested over time, so I'm happy to announce that from now on you'll be able to run Mosaico separately from Steam client. This also means that if you set the [b]"Run at Windows startup"[/b] option, Steam client will not run anymore.

This feature has been available for beta users for about two weeks. Now that it is implemented in the main branch, you may want to disable your  participation at the beta.  

[h1]What changes now?[/h1]
This change was made possible by the integration of a new licensing system. This system is developed in-house and it's separated from Steam DRM. If you own Mosaico you received a [b]serial key[/b] that's used to register Mosaico with our license server. Registration happens silently so there's no need to manually input the serial key. [b]In future it will possible to use this key to register the retail version of Mosaico[/b], which is downloadable from here: [url=www.soulidstudio.com]www.soulidstudio.com[/url]. At the moment though, this is still not possible, so please be patient :)

Also please note that "In game: Mosaico" will be shown for about 10 minutes overall, before being hidden permanently. This is intended to give you enough "play time" to be able to write a review on Steam.

[h1]What's new?[/h1]
This version is 1.8.1. Here's a list of changes:

[list]
[*]New feature to import and export snapshots. Save your snapshots on a file and load them on another PC to have the same work environment.
[*]New feature to import and export settings. Export your settings to another computer or just save more than one profile to use on the same PC.
[*]Change settings folder. You can set Mosaico to store snapshots and settings in a folder of your choice. For example a shared folder over a network.
[*]Fixed a bug where recycled windows handles may cause restored windows to be swapped.
[*]Steam version doesn't show "In game: Mosaico" anymore
[*]Fixed a bug where maximized windows would be restored on a wrong monitor
[*]Mosaico now remembers its position and size through reboots.
[/list]

[b][u]Please feel free to contact us at info@soulidstudio.com or here in the forums if you have any questions/suggestions, thanks![/u][/b]

notes.title: How to remove "In App: Mosaico".
notes.content:
Hi!

It is now possible to run Mosaico without Steam showing your player status as "In App: Mosaico".
This feature is still in beta and will be available soon for everyone. 
If you want to help us and test this feature you can join the beta right now!

[h1]How to join the beta[/h1]

[list]
    [*]In Steam client right click on Mosaico and select "Properties"
    [*]Select the "BETA" tab
    [*]Insert the code "mosaicopublicbeta" (without quotes) 
    [*]Click "Check code" button and wait for confirmation message
    [*]Select "public_beta - Mosaico public beta" from the drop-down menu
    [*]Wait for Mosaico to update
    [*]Launch Mosaico and select "PUBLIC BETA" as launch option
[/list]

If everything was OK you should now be running version 1.8.0.5 b2 S, please check it in "Settings -> About". 

[b][u]The "In App: Mosaico" status will be shown for 10 minutes in total[/u][/b] to give the opportunity to new users to reach the minimum play time needed to write a review. After this period it won't be shown anymore.

If you don't want to join the beta you can launch Mosaico using the "Start Mosaico" launch option. Please note that if you don't join the beta even launching Mosaico with "PUBLIC BETA" launch option will result in old version (1.8.0.3S) being launched.

[b][u]Please let me know if you have any problems running this beta, thanks![/u][/b]


[h1]How it works.[/h1]
Running Mosaico outside of Steam is made possible by an external licensing system. If you own Mosaico [u]you should have been assigned a third-party license code[/u]. When you join the beta and launch Mosaico through "PUBLIC BETA" launch option, Mosaico will try to register to the server using this code automatically. So please be sure to be connected to the internet when you launch the beta for the first time.

Please note that this code currently doesn't work with the retail version of Mosaico, although the integration is planned. In the future you will be able to download and register the retail version with the code provided via Steam.

The provided code can be activated on 3 different PCs before locking. When and if this happen please drop a message to info@soulidstudio.com and I'll extend the validity for you.

[h1]What's new in 1.8.0.5.[/h1]
Here's a list of changes for the new version in beta:

[list]
[*]New feature to import and export snapshots. Save your snapshots on a file and load them on another PC to have the same work environment.
[*]New feature to import and export settings. Export your settings to another computer or just save more than one profile to use on the same PC.
[*]Change settings folder. You can set Mosaico to store snapshots and settings in a folder of your choice. For example a shared folder over a network.
[*]Fixed a bug where recycled windows handles may cause restored windows to be swapped.
[*]Steam version doesn't show "In App: Mosaico" anymore
[*]Fixed a bug where maximized windows would be restored on a wrong monitor
[*]Mosaico now remember its position and size through reboots.
[/list]

notes.title: Mosaico bugfix version 1.8.0.3 is available
notes.content:
A [b]new bugfix release[/b] of Mosaico is available for download at [url=http://www.soulidstudio.com/]www.soulidstudio.com[/url].

[h1]The change list for this [b]version 1.8.0.3[/b] is:[/h1]
- [b]Fixed a bug[/b] where some snapshots were [b]not restored using the full screen area[/b] in the monitor hosting a Windows taskbar (you will need to capture the snapshots again).
- It is now possible to [b]disable the exit confirmation dialog[/b].
- It is now possible to [b]disable docking&tabifying[/b] when Mosaico is near screen edges.
- Added a [b]"Please wait" message[/b] when a snapshot is being restored.
- It is now possible to [b]activate and register Mosaico via email[/b], for PCs not connected to the internet.

[h1]To update your copy of Mosaico please:[/h1]
- [b]uninstall[/b] your current version;
- [b]reboot[/b] your PC (please do this! Otherwise you may end up with an unclean installation);
- [b]install[/b] the new version.

If you own Mosaico on [b]Steam [/b]your copy should be automatically updating.

If you don't own a license of Mosaico yet, you can try this new version for an additional [b]14 days[/b] period!

The[b] new licensing system[/b] that will open a lot of new possibilities for bringing Mosaico to your company is almost finished, please stay tuned! If you own Mosaico on Steam this system will allow you to run Mosaico without running Steam client.

notes.title: A new version of Mosaico is available! (1.8.0)
notes.content:
[h1]A new version of Mosaico is available for download![/h1]

This new [b]1.8.0[/b] version introduces several new features and fixes various bugs reported from the previous version.

If you own a license [b]you can upgrade for free[/b]. Just uninstall your current version, reboot your computer and install this new 1.8.0 version.

If you have already tried Mosaico in the past but your copy has expired, you can download this new version for an [b]extended 14-days trial period![/b]

You can download Mosaico 1.8.0 at [url=http://www.soulidstudio.com/downloads/mosaico_setup.exe]http://www.soulidstudio.com/downloads/mosaico_setup.exe[/url]

[h1]These are some of the [b]new features[/b] you can find in 1.8.0:[/h1]

[list]
[*]Snapshots have now a fixed, customizable, position, so they are more easily restored via key shortcuts.
[*]It is now possible to assign a name to a snapshot.
[*]It is now possible to set command line arguments for each app in a snapshot. Command line arguments are captured as well.
[*]It is now possible to apply activate/delete actions to a selection of apps instead of one by one.
[*]Apps list is sortable.
[*]New options make snapshot restoring customizable.
[*]Better performance in user interface and in restoring process.
[*]Improved algorithm to match windows on screen with the apps in a snapshot.
[*]It is now possible to choose which layouts to display on screen when arranging.
[*]It is now possible to choose which layouts to use when arranging via hotkeys.
[*]Pressing "Q" will cancel current arrangement (same as "right mouse button").
[*]Snapshots will now adapt to a new screen resolution when it changes. 
[*]Layouts are now displayed on screen in a less cluttered way.
[*]Several minor GUI improvements.
[/list]

[h1]Among the bug fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Snapshots are now correctly saved on exit.
[*]Improved compatibility with known third party software (i.e. WinAmp, Aimp, Steam etc.)
[*]Fixed a bug with maximized windows.
[*]Fixed a bug with arrangement overlay appearing only the first time on Windows 8.1.
[*]Fixed a bug with "skewed" layouts after resolution changing.
[/list]

Mosaico is also available for purchase on Steam, Valve’s digital store! You can find it here [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/257650/]http://store.steampowered.com/app/257650/[/url]

This version introduces several changes, but many more are going to be implemented in the near future. If you'd like to suggest a feature, or report a bug, please feel free to contact us at [b]info@soulidstudio.com[/b] of on the Mosaico community pages on Steam. Mosaico is a tool created to improve your experience when working at the PC, so every suggestion is welcome!

Enjoy your copy of Mosaico!

You can download Mosaico 1.8.0 at [url=http://www.soulidstudio.com/downloads/mosaico_setup.exe]http://www.soulidstudio.com/downloads/mosaico_setup.exe[/url]

[h1]These are some of the [b]new features[/b] you can find in 1.8.0:[/h1]

[list]
[*]Snapshots have now a fixed, customizable, position, so they are more easily restored via key shortcuts.
[*]It is now possible to assign a name to a snapshot.
[*]It is now possible to set command line arguments for each app in a snapshot. Command line arguments are captured as well.
[*]It is now possible to apply activate/delete actions to a selection of apps instead of one by one.
[*]Apps list is sortable.
[*]New options make snapshot restoring customizable.
[*]Better performance in user interface and in restoring process.
[*]Improved algorithm to match windows on screen with the apps in a snapshot.
[*]It is now possible to choose which layouts to display on screen when arranging.
[*]It is now possible to choose which layouts to use when arranging via hotkeys.
[*]Pressing "Q" will cancel current arrangement (same as "right mouse button").
[*]Snapshots will now adapt to a new screen resolution when it changes. 
[*]Layouts are now displayed on screen in a less cluttered way.
[*]Several minor GUI improvements.
[/list]

[h1]Among the bug fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Snapshots are now correctly saved on exit.
[*]Improved compatibility with known third party software (i.e. WinAmp, Aimp, Steam etc.)
[*]Fixed a bug with maximized windows.
[*]Fixed a bug with arrangement overlay appearing only the first time on Windows 8.1.
[*]Fixed a bug with "skewed" layouts after resolution changing.
[/list]

Mosaico is also available for purchase on Steam, Valve’s digital store! You can find it here [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/257650/]http://store.steampowered.com/app/257650/[/url]

This version introduces several changes, but many more are going to be implemented in the near future. If you'd like to suggest a feature, or report a bug, please feel free to contact us at [b]info@soulidstudio.com[/b] of on the Mosaico community pages on Steam. Mosaico is a tool created to improve your experience when working at the PC, so every suggestion is welcome!

Enjoy your copy of Mosaico!
